pull.title: Test: Add legacy script edge case spender test
pull.body:
Move the spender framework from feature_taproot.py to test_framework/spenders.py, and use it in a new feature_legacy_script.py test for script edge cases that other implementations have gotten wrong: CSV with -2, a 5-byte operand whose value fits in 1 byte, IFDUP on negative or non-minimal zero, ROLL with duplicate values, OP_16 in a P2SH scriptSig, and a P2SH scriptSig that leaves 1,000 items for the scriptPubKey to run on.

The first commit is move-only. The new test supports --dumptests like feature_taproot.py, which is how the cases get into the script assets.

These were discovered by finding gaps in alternate implementations (bitcoin-s and rbitcoin)

Script assets: bitcoin-core/qa-assets#297

Since they survive regeneration and add coverage, I don't see why not. The dumps are how they get into the script assets.

I also moved the P2SH stack-size spender here from #36465, as you suggested there. I'll update qa-assets#297 as well

Test coverage for surprising consensus-critical logic should take precedence, so not a blocker, but i dislike that this adds legacy-only cases to a test supposed to test Taproot logic. If we find the framework of this test is useful, which clearly is the case, then i think it should be exported to other non-Taproot specific tests. But also non-Taproot script test cases need less structure, so if you can just add those to script_tests.json & co as part of #36458 that's also a refactor we can punt down to another time.
@benthecarman how do you want to proceed here?

Test: Move spender framework out of feature_taproot

Move the context signing framework, the spender helpers, and the
test_spenders() runner from feature_taproot.py to a new
test_framework/spenders.py module, so that tests other than the
Taproot one can use them and dump script assets.

The runner methods go in a SpenderTestMixin class, since the test
framework's metaclass doesn't allow an intermediate subclass of
BitcoinTestFramework.

Move-only, apart from imports and the mixin declaration.

Test: Add legacy script edge case spender test

Add feature_legacy_script.py, which uses the spender framework for
script edge cases that other implementations have gotten wrong: CSV
with -2, a 5-byte operand whose value fits in 1 byte, IFDUP on
negative or non-minimal zero, ROLL with duplicate values, OP_16 in a
P2SH scriptSig, and a P2SH scriptSig that leaves 1,000 items for the
scriptPubKey to run on.

None of the current script assets catch an interpreter that gets
these wrong. Like feature_taproot.py, the test can dump its cases
with --dumptests, so list it in the script assets minimizer
instructions.
